page.overview:
Who is Masters?

The Masters are a group of entities from Final Fantasy Legend III. Xagor is acting as the leader of the Masters, and they all dwell in Pureland, the home of the Masters. The Masters have enslaved the citizen of Pureland, who cannot fight or oppose them. They intend to rule Pureland, but a group of rebels lead by Borgin against the Masters are the only ones who can stop them from achieving their goals.

Category:Antagonists Category:Races in the Legend series
